//: ISI-7096 (child of ISI-7088) missing-summary Davis detector. The regression guard for the two-phase comment feature (ISI-7094): fires when a run reaches a terminal state carrying ZERO kind='summary' comments. Deploy with `dtctl create anomaly-detector -f run-summary-presence-detector.json`. RAW Settings API format {schemaId, scope, value} — dtctl's flattened format mangles eventTemplate.properties (ISI-5488). The analyzer MUST be the `ui` variant with input key `query`; the non-ui StaticThresholdAnomalyDetectionAnalyzer uses `timeSeriesData` and is rejected by builtin:davis.anomaly-detectors. STATUS: schema-built + DQL syntax-validated against oat05854; goes live once ksquad.run.summary.present flows (operator carrying ISI-7096 deployed + a terminal run). Live-verify tracked on ISI-7096 follow-up.

This is the ISI-7088 two-phase invariant regressing: the platform synthesize-fallback in coord/settle.go should guarantee exactly one summary per completed run. Investigate: pkg/coord/settle.go (synthesizeSummary), the terminal settle callers (prodeffects.go / rundrive/store.go), and the coord.comment rows for the affected run.
